verdict.summary: The new per-invocation V2 selection is correctly feature-gated and fail-closed: flag validation occurs before loading/opening data, feature-off builds reject V2 requests, and the thread-local override encloses the real save_compressed call. The subprocess tests exercise the actual argv-to-disk path, verify file magic for both save and recompress, cover feature-off rejection and malformed usage, confirm the environment precedence rule, and compare query results across V1 and V2. The CLI documentation is updated consistently. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found in the supplied diff.
